name: SZL Obsidian Signal
purpose: One premium interaction grammar with a distinct visual instrument for every SZL product, proof surface, and application Space.

inspiration_principles.editorial_clarity: Large human-readable typography, calm hierarchy, generous whitespace, and precise language.
inspiration_principles.orbital_depth: Cinematic spatial composition, mission-control framing, and disciplined darkness without game-like chrome.
inspiration_principles.performance_materiality: Dimensional surfaces, restrained specular light, progressive enhancement, and small runtime budgets.
inspiration_principles.observability_legibility: Operational information is organized by signal, state, confidence, evidence, and action.
inspiration_principles.agentic_workflows: Human and machine handoffs remain visible without implying unmeasured autonomy.
inspiration_principles.premium_storytelling: Product narrative and interaction hierarchy carry the experience; ornament never competes with evidence.

originality_boundary: No copied source code, graphics, trademarks, layouts, illustrations, motion sequences, or proprietary assets.
Reference companies inform design principles only; all implementation, motifs, tokens, copy, and components are SZL-original.
Decorative motion is labeled and never presented as measured telemetry.
Operational claims remain bound to measured evidence and existing honesty contracts.

shared_contract.progressive_enhancement: CSS first; decorative Canvas is optional; content and evidence remain usable without motion
